documents.title: Press Release - CPCL Financial Performance For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30.09.2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) reported its financial and operational performance for Q4 and FY 2025-26, highlighting record-high crude throughput, distillate yield, and production levels. Management discussed the company's flexible crude sourcing strategy involving term and spot contracts, continued operational efficiencies, and a comfortable leverage position. The company also outlined ongoing capital expenditure plans, including projects for Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS and retail outlets, alongside robust dividend payouts. Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) reported strong physical performance for FY 2024-25, achieving a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT and setting records in energy efficiency, low fuel and loss levels, and value-added product sales. Financial results were impacted by lower international product cracks compared to the previous year, with a full-year Gross Refining Margin (GRM) of $4.22 per barrel.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the normal maintenance Capex for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores.
guidance.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

guidance.claim: Management stated that with the inclusion of the LOBS project, the total Capex for each of the next two years is expected to be around Rs. 700 to Rs. 800 crores.
guidance.quote: And with this project, another Rs. 400 to Rs. 500 crores you can add for each of the year. So, without this project, about Rs. 300 crores per year. With this project, about Rs. 700 to Rs. 800 crores per year.

guidance.claim: Management expects throughput in the current year to be higher than last year on the operational part due to lower shutdown impact.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a throughput which is higher than last year on the operational part.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the southern market has a clear shortfall in Motor Spirit (MS) production compared to demand, estimated at close to 20 TMT per month.
demand_outlook.quote: MS in southern market, there is a clear shortfall so, the production is less than demand. It is close to about 20 TMT per month.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that southern market demand projections align closely with national growth forecasts, with MS projected at 4%-5% and HSD at 3%.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as others are concerned, we have seen the southern market to be mostly aligned to the national growth projection. Like MS, they are projecting 6% and here we see around 4%-5%. HSD we see at 3% growth forecast, as against 2.5% odd here.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has approved all clearances for the Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project, and project execution has started in full swing.
capex_expansion.quote: Some of the important projects that we'll be taking up is Group 2, Group 3 LOBS for which all approvals are in place and the project execution has started in full swing.

capex_expansion.claim: The retail outlet endeavor has commenced, and commissioning will be seen during the '26-'27 financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: Even our retail outlet endeavor for which we had taken 300 licenses has started. And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

capex_expansion.claim: The LOBS project is budgeted at INR1,600 crores and the retail outlet project at INR400 crores, totaling INR2,000 crores to be spent over 2 to 3 years.
capex_expansion.quote: LOBS project, Group 2, Group 3 LOBS project is INR1,600 crores. The retail outlet project is INR400 crores. So that makes it INR2,000 crores. This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Normal annual capex is estimated at another INR500 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Besides, every year, you can assume another INR500 crores is our normal capex.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL spent Rs. 673 crores as Capex during the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: On the CAPEX front, in the current year, we have spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX for the current year.

capex_expansion.claim: The revised capital cost for the Cauvery Basin Refinery (CBR) project is Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian Oil.
capex_expansion.quote: The revised capital cost is at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian oil respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL has full custody of the land for the CBR project, with both previously held and newly acquired land totaling about 1,200 acres in their possession.
capex_expansion.quote: The most important updates with respect to the project is now we have full custody of the land. So, about 600 acres, which was already with CPCL and another 600 acres, which was acquired in the process, both is in our possession and the pre-project activities of boundary wall construction, and all those things are almost at a big stage.

margins_costs.claim: The gross refining margin for quarter 4 was $13.75 per barrel compared to the Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for quarter 4 was $13.75 barrel as compared to Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel, which again reiterates that all these efficiencies are constant, continuous and are being sustained over each period.

margins_costs.claim: The core GRM for the fourth quarter was reported at $10.3 per barrel.
Foreign exchange losses were approximately INR200 crores for the quarter and around INR350 crores for the whole year.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter, it would be for the quarter, it is approximately INR 200 crores,. And for the whole year, it will be around INR350 crores.

margins_costs.claim: CPCL reported a full-year GRM of $4.22 per barrel for FY 2024-25 compared to $8.64 per barrel in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for 2024-25 for a full year basis is $4.22 per barrel as compared to the previous year $8.64 per barrel, but if you compare it to Singapore benchmark which was $3.79 per barrel in the current year, we have performed better.

margins_costs.claim: For Quarter 4, the GRM was $6.22 per barrel compared to $7.7 per barrel in the same quarter of the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: On Quarter 4, our GRM was $6.22 per barrel. Again, if I compare the previous year same quarter, it was $7.7 per barrel, but if I compare it to Singapore benchmark, which was only $3.1 per barrel.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory gain for the fourth quarter was $0.66 per barrel, amounting to Rs. 125 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory gain is not very significant for the quarter. It is only $ 0.66 per barrel. And in absolute rupee terms, it is Rs. 125 crores only.

margins_costs.claim: For the full year, the inventory resulted in a loss of $0.06 per barrel, totaling Rs. 40 crores.
margins_costs.quote: But on an overall annual basis, the inventory would be a loss that is $ 0.06 per barrel, Rs. 40 crores in amount.

margins_costs.claim: The fuel and loss for the year came down to 8.51%.
margins_costs.quote: and in that context, the fuel and loss has come down to 8.51% for the year as a whole.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported operating expenditure (net) of 945 Crore for 9M 2024-25.
Provision for contingent liabilities was 9 Crore for 9M 2024-25.
Exchange variation loss stood at 122 Crore for 9M 2024-25.
CST under recovery was 246 Crore for 9M 2024-25.
Interest expenses were reported at 165 Crore for 9M 2024-25.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved its highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, equivalent to 112% of installed capacity during the financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, million metric ton, which equivalents to 112% of installed capacity, breaking records of our previous best of 11.64 MMT achieved in financial year 2023-'24.

orders_capacity.claim: During quarter 4, CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 2.93 MMT, which is 111% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In quarter 4 of the current financial year, CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 2.93 MMT, which is also 111% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The new Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project will add 250 KTPA of fresh capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: My new unit will take me to a 250,000, 250 KTPA in Group 2, Group 3 capacity, and that will be a fresh addition.

orders_capacity.claim: For Quarter 4, crude throughput was 2.974 MMT, representing 113% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: and coming on to Quarter 4, the crude throughput was 2.974, which is 113% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Total crude throughput for 9M 2024-25 was 7,480 TMT.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt-to-equity stands at 0.18 at a gross level compared to 0.39 in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: Our leverage position now stands at 0.18. Our debt equity stands at 0.18 at a gross level as compared to 0.39 last year.

capital_allocation.claim: On a gross basis, borrowings are INR1,900 crores, while net borrowings are INR973 crores, resulting in a net debt ratio of 0.09.
capital_allocation.quote: On a gross basis, the borrowings are INR1,900 crores, but on a net basis, it is less than INR1,000 crores, to be precise, INR973 crores. If we consider net borrowing, the debt ratio is only 0.09, which is less than 0.1.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, which, along with the interim dividend of INR8 per share, brings the total dividend for the year to INR62 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year, for the first time, CPCL paid an interim dividend, and we are happy to announce that in addition to the interim dividend of INR8 per equity share of INR10 each, the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, taking the total dividend for the year to INR62 per share, which again is highest ever.

capital_allocation.claim: Capital expenditure for the current year stood at INR856 crores compared to INR673 crores in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the current year, the capex was INR856 crores as compared to INR673 crores in the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt at an absolute level stood at Rs. 3,100 crores as on March 31, 2025, compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as on March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: At an absolute level, the debt stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as on March 31, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: Net worth was reported at Rs. 7,939 crores as on March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Net worth is at Rs. 7,939 crores as on March 31, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share, representing 50% of the face value for the current year.
capital_allocation.quote: the Board has also recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year and as we all know, this is subject to approval at AGM, which will happen in the due course.

risks_headwinds.claim: Logistical constraints and volatility of crude oil prices pose challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: I would like to say the uncertainties due to logistical constraints, volatility of crude oil prices do pose challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that uncertainties due to the volatility of crude prices pose a challenge.
risks_headwinds.quote: Finally, the uncertainties due to volatility of crude prices do pose a challenge.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company reported a profit before tax loss of 374 Crore for 9M 2024-25.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to commission a significant number of retail outlets during the financial year '26-'27.
management_commitments.quote: Even our retail outlet endeavor for which we had taken 300 licenses has started. And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

management_commitments.claim: The INR2,000 crores capex for the LOBS and retail outlet projects will be deployed over 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that on a sustained basis, fuel and loss indexes will be brought down to very efficient levels.
management_commitments.quote: and we went to a roadmap where we said on a sustained basis, we will bring it down to very efficient levels and in that context, the fuel and loss has come down to 8.51% for the year as a whole.

management_commitments.claim: Management affirmed a commitment to develop new schemes on energy efficiency, lower the fuel and loss roadmap further, and develop enhanced production of value-added products.
management_commitments.quote: To summarize the physical performance, we are committed to develop new schemes on energy efficiency, take the fuel and loss reduction roadmap further lower and then develop enhanced production of value-added products as well going forward.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to maintaining capital discipline by adhering to optimum return on value-added and growth projects to create long-term value for shareholders.
management_commitments.quote: and thereby honouring our commitment to create long-term value for shareholders.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
